name: POS Auto Discount
description: This App will auto apply already configured product discount in POS cart for user convenient and faster process.
summary: The EG POS Auto Discount module for Odoo automatically applies pre-configured product discounts in the POS cart. This saves time for cashiers, ensures consistent pricing, and speeds up the checkout process, providing a smoother and more convenient experience for both staff and customers. Make discounts effortless with the POS Auto Discount Module for Odoo. This smart extension automatically applies pre-configured product discounts directly in the POS cart, eliminating the need for manual input by cashiers. Customers instantly see their savings at checkout, creating a transparent, rewarding, and smooth shopping experience. Designed for promotions, seasonal sales, or loyalty programs, the module ensures that discounts are consistently and correctly applied, reducing errors and saving valuable time during high-volume transactions. By automating discount management, it enhances cashier efficiency, checkout speed, and customer satisfaction. Seamlessly integrated with Odoo’s POS workflow, this module provides a user-friendly, automated discount solution for any business running regular promotions.
